work.author: Pius pr. VL
work.description: Entire refined Coruche hospital inheritance faculty and at least 20 LF context read. Own dating/Expositio/Tenor blocks LF68802–68817 are separable from body and retained; genuine title starts LF68821, literal papal protocol is LF68836, and all three clauses, the separate Derogatio marginal block LF68932–68933, and terminal dating LF68957–68962 continue in order. This is distinct from the Nursia indult. Literal OCR Pius pr.VL is preserved, with Pius Sextus running attribution in the continuous printing; no word-level image collation is claimed. The marginal date lead and closing differ in OCR, so date remains null. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
